statements.action_statement: VideoQ builds the local 3.5.9-r100 package using apps/security/openssl/APKBUILD. The Alpine 5e6d18a5ba2eec060b34a671a43ee54a5e72714a recipe and all existing backports are retained; five additional checksum-pinned upstream commits are recorded in upstream-fixes.json. All patches and the OpenSSL source archive are checksum-verified by abuild; the OpenSSL test suite runs before signing these APKs. This statement covers only the locally built r100 identities, never upstream r0/r1 or unrelated CVEs. See apps/security/openssl/README.md.
